use_case.problem: Employees need to interpret an internal purchasing policy and prepare exception requests safely.
use_case.success_metric: Rate of policy answers supported by the applicable policy version, subject to human review.
use_case.non_ai_alternative: A rule-based decision tree and a searchable document portal.

evidence.summary: Employees report difficulty locating the applicable purchasing policy.

evidence.source: synthetic policy document — not yet implemented
evidence.summary: A fictional purchasing policy will be provided for the technical reference case.

decision.rationale: A use case is specified, but the business baseline and policy corpus have not been verified.
